description: This file defines the class SimpleMouseRotator, which manages mouse or mobile input to rotate a GameObject in Unity, implementing constrained rotation based on user input with optional auto-zeroing behavior.

classes.name: SimpleMouseRotator
classes.description: A MonoBehaviour that rotates a GameObject based on mouse or mobile input with configurable constraints and behaviors.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the original rotation of the GameObject at the start.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Reads input, updates target angles, applies constraints, and smoothly interpolates rotation each frame.
